title: Fail-closed l9-plan-simple pipeline
objective: Make /l9-plan-simple fail closed so an invocation runs l9-global-architect and emits a plan whose required sections validate with no unknown or unbound markers. GAR run gar-fail-closed-20261105 is STANDALONE (orchestration authority was not transferred). Realization mode is MUTATION by OBJECTIVE_DERIVATION RM-001. Validation is required by VD-001. Delivery is PERSISTED_REPOSITORY by DL-003. Depth profile is DEEP because the blast radius crosses the skill, the plan schema, and the hook plane. First-Order intervention, bound before architecture: one pipeline is the only admissible writer of a simple plan. Governing cause is verified from the two host plan cards and from the scripts: the host accepts a plan with no architect proof, and validate_plan_document.py plus render_plan_pe_autonomy.py treat a half-filled plan as success. Kill-pattern hypothesis KP-001 is confirmed: CreatePlan and the renderer are two writers of the same artifact with no consistency protocol. Selected architecture stays inside that intervention: run_plan_pipeline.py sequences the existing validator and renderer, a GAR run file is mandatory for this skill only, and admit_plan.py rejects any other simple plan. Standalone GAR persistence stays optional for other callers. The L9 architecture profile applies as a constraint on this governance skill and does not activate L9_INTEGRATED. Evaluator result for the host plan-tool payload is UNKNOWN (U2).
success_criteria: V1 proves run_plan_pipeline.py exits non-zero when the GAR run file is absent
V2 proves validate_plan_document.py rejects a document that omits owner, execution_envelope, complexity, or todo layer

V4 proves admit_plan.py exits non-zero on a title-and-paragraph plan
V5 proves validate_plan_section_receipt.py exits non-zero when gar_upstream.invoked is true and the GAR run file is absent
V6 proves render_plan_pe_autonomy.py without --execute-via still emits the Program Execution heading for a complete document
